purpose: Prevent partial Ask the Model release/version updates by requiring the public version and release date to move atomically across all version-bearing public metadata before Flatpak build or GitHub Release publication.

versioning_basis.policy: Release version changes are deliberate. A minor release is appropriate when substantial backward-compatible user-facing functionality is added; patch releases are reserved for compatible corrections.

current_public_release.reason: A v0.8.0 minor-release candidate is prepared for the bounded source-qualified BNR BLS C01 quarterly chart route. The public v0.7.1 tag and bundle remain immutable; the candidate must pass exact-head metadata/Flatpak validation and manual acceptance of the exact Flatpak artifact on elementary OS 8 before a metadata-bearing main merge can trigger publication.

synchronized_surfaces.rule: project version is the canonical application version
top-level version and date-released match the canonical release
primary release badge alt text exposes the exact current version
Current release line contains the exact version and release date
released section heading is '## VERSION - YYYY-MM-DD'
file exists; title and release subtitle/date match the exact release
the first AppStream <release> entry matches the exact version and release date

deliberately_not_application_version.reason: This field declares the Desktop Entry file-format/specification version and must not be rewritten to the AtM application version.

workflow_gate.placement: before README validation and Flatpak build
workflow_gate.release_publisher: The existing workflow derives the tag from meson.build and requires releases/vVERSION.md before publishing.
workflow_gate.failure_policy: Any version/date mismatch fails before the expensive Flatpak build and before release publication.

future_release_rule.repository_grounded_chat: Repository selection, exact-SHA snapshots, grounded context and inspectable citations are public v0.3.0 functionality and must remain covered by release documentation and regression gates.
future_release_rule.patch_documentation: Documentation-only or compatible bug corrections may use a patch release when deliberately published as a new immutable release.
future_release_rule.new_capability: Substantial new user-facing capability should normally prepare a new 0.x minor release while the public API remains pre-1.0.
future_release_rule.startup_integrity: v0.4.0 introduced offline startup qualification and local snapshot-integrity verification; later releases must preserve the distinction between upstream Git revision identity and AtM local integrity seals.
future_release_rule.saved_conversation_history: v0.5.0 makes explicit Save to History the only user-visible conversation save transition; later lifecycle changes must preserve exact-context restore and fail-closed permanent deletion semantics unless deliberately redesigned and documented.
future_release_rule.presentation: v0.6.0 qualifies semantic transcript presentation and accessible grounded Sources; future presentation changes must preserve provider/persistence content and citation provenance boundaries.
future_release_rule.optimizations: The v0.6.0 Optimizations switch is session-only and defaults OFF. Optional qualified runtime paths remain individually bounded and switch-gated. B0 repository-authority mutation coordination and B2 positive-generation shared leases are mandatory correctness coordination and stay active in OFF and ON modes; this does not authorize destructive GC.
future_release_rule.charting: The v0.8.0 release adds the bounded, source-qualified BNR BLS C01 quarterly profile from the exact pinned RMD snapshot alongside GISTEMP v1 and Energy Institute TES v2. The BNR path preserves 12 quarter coordinates with 11 numeric observations and one explicit missing 2025-Q2 point; no physical row or numeric zero is invented, Data displays none, the renderer leaves the gap open, and History requalifies from the pinned recipe/source identity. Broader CHART-01 remains open: generic or arbitrary sources, multi-series/derived charts and generalized missing/event/discontinuity semantics are not implied; M4 remains dormant.

release_candidate.scope: Add only the bounded source-qualified BNR BLS C01 quarterly route from the exact pinned RMD snapshot alongside unchanged GISTEMP v1 and Energy Institute TES v2. Preserve 12 quarter coordinates, 11 numeric observations, the authorized 2025-Q2 missing point with no physical row/value, Data none, gap-aware rendering and recipe-only History reconstruction. No generic charting or broader CHART-01 qualification is implied.
